name: Herefordshire Nature and Biodiversity Community Grant Scheme
summary: Small grants for constituted non-profits in Herefordshire to plant trees and hedges, create wetlands, ponds and wildflower areas and other lasting habitat work, in a round that closed on 31 August 2026.

amount.note: Up to £35,000 considered where significant benefits are shown

reporting: An interim or final report within six months of claiming the grant, summarising what the project achieved.

status.quote: The deadline for applications was midnight on Monday 31 August 2026.

opens.quote: The grant scheme re-opened to applications on 1 June 2026.

deadline.quote: The deadline for applications was midnight on Monday 31 August 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be a formally constituted non-profit business or organisation based in Herefordshire, such as a registered charity, community interest company or a relevant parish council.

geography.quote: Applicants must be a formally constituted non-profit business or organisation based in Herefordshire, such as a registered charity, community interest company or a relevant parish council.

access.quote: The grant scheme re-opened to applications on 1 June 2026.

window.quote: The deadline for applications was midnight on Monday 31 August 2026.

amount.quote: The minimum amount of grant than can be applied for is £500 to a maximum of £10,000 during the lifetime of the grant scheme but applications up to £35,000 will be considered where significant benefits can be demonstrated.

co_finance_required.quote: While match funding is not required, applications which can also demonstrate match or in-kind funding support are encouraged.

reporting.quote: you will need to complete either an interim, or a final report within six months of claiming your grant, summarising what your project has achieved.

administered_by.quote: Once received, FCC Environment will acknowledge receipt of your grant application.
